methods.O-G: Fresh retained reference graph + fresh selected moments + common solve
methods.O-T: Correct oracle selected IDs + fresh moments + common solve; excludes graph work
methods.B-E-signed-python: Existing string-indexed eligible payload with signed batched moment updates
methods.B-E-compact-common: Integer-indexed eligible payload; rebuild selected moments at release
methods.P-I-jointspan-common: Indexed joint-span aggregate summary; recover moments at release
methods.B-F: Fresh ridge on retained initially selected records; intentionally wrong curation target

unsupported.S: This runner presently supports record-service paths only; source requests are not relabeled
unsupported.P-S: Full coefficient-map scan comparator not integrated
unsupported.P-R: Protocol rank-coordinate scan comparator not integrated; joint-span P-I is distinct
unsupported.O-R: Standard SemDeDup complete refit branch not integrated
unsupported.B-E-optimized-CSR: Current signed-payload branch is Python dictionary/set code, not the protocol optimized CSR performance baseline
unsupported.compact-native-decoders: Optional dual/joint-span decoders excluded here to hold decoder identical
unsupported.primary-study: Requires full registered branches, real assets/ratings, independent workers and externally reviewed execution lock

lambda_regularizer: lambda * current selected count; all coordinates penalized; no intercept
common_decoder: core.solve_ridge FP64 primal Cholesky; empty selection returns zero
checkpoint_failures: preserve row and mark later path checkpoints not executed; never reroll
timing_scope: single process wall time; shared inputs and warm caches; audits excluded; no benchmark claim
memory_scope: state numeric arrays and recursive owned-byte estimates; no RSS/peak/allocator claim
